name: Herr Hildezart - feed the hamster
author: Hoschie
description:
Herr Hildezart is so hungry! Help him to find tasty food and avoid unhealthy snacks. Use the arrow keys and make him jump with the space bar. 
Help him collect the nomnomnom seeds and watch his cheeks grow. You  have 60 seconds to collect them and avoid the hot chili at all costs. Herr Hildezart hates them so much, he looses his hard earned seeds.
And while sugar is not healthy for rodents you have to avoid the cakes and muffins, even if they look tasty. Collect good and healthy vegetables instead and keep you hamster happy and healthy
